jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
**Building Healthcare That Remembers**


Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to.


At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 270 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1\.6 million decision pathways.


We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026\. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C at a $1\.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!


Healthcare spends $1\.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Research Engineer, you’ll be responsible for building industry\-leading healthcare AI models and model pipelines that power Assort’s voice agents and overall patient platform, taking them all the way from idea to production. You’ll own large initiatives that push the boundary of what models and agents can accomplish in the healthcare space while maintaining high levels of reliability, efficiency, and precision of accomplishing tasks.


We’re looking for strong research engineers who want to build the core models and algorithms behind our core platform and agents. People here own their work end\-to\-end, ship real improvements, and are trusted to make high\-impact technical decisions.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Lead research and engineering efforts to improve core conversational capabilities in production, including instruction following, tool calling, retrieval, and memory
* Investigate research questions in speech and audio, and design experiments to test hypotheses about model behavior and capabilities
* Build and iterate on end\-to\-end models and pipelines that optimize for quality, efficiency, and user experience
* Identify opportunities for model\-task optimization to ensure the right model architectures are used for different tasks based on performance, latency, and cost
* Partner with platform and product engineers to integrate new models into production systems
* Break down ambiguous research ideas into clear, iterative milestones and roadmaps
* Train, fine\-tune, validate, and further develop models built in\-house at Hume and models developed by our customers
* Design evaluation protocols and benchmarks that measure model quality, generalization, robustness, and progress against research objectives
* Analyze datasets, model outputs, and failure cases; compare training approaches and use the evidence to guide the next round of model development

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience with a minimum of 3\+ in AI/ML engineering or research
* Prior experience post\-training and deploying LLMs in production environments
* Fluency in Python and modern ML tooling (training, evaluation, inference, data pipelines)
* Track record of taking research ideas from prototype reliable, measurable production impact
* Strong experimental judgment: formulating hypotheses, establishing useful baselines, designing evaluations, and interpreting results carefully
* (Bonus) Prior experience utilizing and improving speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS) models, and/or duplex models


A PhD is not required. We value demonstrated research ability and the quality of the models, experiments, and systems you have helped build.

**Benefits \& Perks for Assorties**
===================================

* **Competitive Compensation** – Including salary *and* employee stock options so you share in our success.
* **Lifelong Learning** – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.
* **Office Setup Stipend** – We’ll outfit your in\-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.
* **Top\-Tier Health Coverage** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.
* **Flexible PTO** – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.
* **Meals \& Snacks** – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.
* **Fitness Stipend** – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.
* **Commuter Benefits** – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.
* **401(k)** – Build your retirement savings.

**How We Work \& What We Value**
================================


Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide *how* we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a **Day One Drive**, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a **5\-Star Focus**, as our customers are our lifeblood, always **Answer the Call**, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with **One Pulse**, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!  

  

**Please note:** the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com email address.


Compensation Range: $190K \- $240K

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real\-time, centimeter\-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.


With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future\-proof, backwards\-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

**Why Xona?**


You'll get to support a growing satellite constellation as you operate the platform serving our worldwide PNT services on AWS and on\-prem, plus our observability backbone built on OpenTelemetry monitoring.  



  

We have a great culture of collaboration across engineering, platform, software, and hardware, and incredible teams building the navigation solutions that will define new generations of technology just as GPS did.  



  

We care about great developer experience and you'll have support to push for great internal DX while enforcing the platform constraints that meet our strict performance and reliability are central requirements.  



  

We're solving hard engineering problems: we want you to work with all of our software teams and understand their unique needs from our platform infrastructure, rather than living in a DevOps silo.  



  

Xona is in a period of strong growth: building out support for the satellite constellation and accelerating partnerships with our enterprise PNT users. You're not just maintaining a dusty, legacy stack, but making sure infrastructure stays reliable and can provide the correctness our customers demand while scaling to a global service.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own cloud operations**: You'll run our environments, from alpha to production, on AWS and Kubernetes. Your team helps software engineers scale their services, plan capacity needs, release often, and optimize costs. You empower different software teams by embedding security and infrastructure best practices into their workflows.
* **Develop best\-in\-class observability:** You'll be on the team that owns our monitoring setup end to end. You implement observability infrastructure to stay ahead of SLOs with dashboards and timely alerts. We favor robust testing and monitoring culture over firefighting in prod; you'll enforce the necessary standards and processes for teams to ship with confidence.
* **Automate everything:** continuous delivery, high availability, hermetic builds, infrastructure\-as\-code, zero\-downtime deployments. You’re comfortable writing quality software in at least one general purpose language. The platform team is always trying to replace manual processes to make things faster and more reproducible.
* **Design for the future**: as Xona's Pulsar constellation goes to 100x, new product directions are a given. You're always thinking about flexibility in our infrastructure and testing/release flows so the foundation lasts.
* **Be a Kubernetes technical leader:** Help establish paved\-road patterns for Kubernetes deployment and operations, and become a trusted source of mentorship for teams orchestrating containers across Xona.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day
* Strong Kubernetes experience, including production operations, deployment tooling, networking, IAM, and GitOps patterns on hyperscale vendors; on\-premises experience (OpenShift/etc) is also a plus.
* Thoughtful about how testing/release workflow design affect system reliability in a microservices architecture
* Experienced with container orchestration (Kubernetes/etc), infrastructure\-as\-code (OpenTofu/Terraform/etc), and cloud networking
* You have great instincts for observability, and your alerts or dashboards caught real problems (OpenTelemetry experience is a plus). You understand what makes for effective tooling for a rapidly scaling software team.
* You're opinionated about how to automate processes, maintain complex systems, and safely ship
* You believe in empowering SWE to understand and manage their deployments and infra autonomously
* You rise to the challenge of working in a small team with outsize impact and visibility.

**Preferred:**
  

Contributions to open source infrastructure tooling (Helm charts, Terraform modules, etc.). Interest in open source build tooling (Bazel/Buck2/Nix/Guix), reproducible/hermetic/etc. builds

**Tech Stack**


We run C\+\+ and Python code in AWS on Kubernetes and Lambda, plus AWS event streaming services; the stack includes Argo for GitOps, Kustomize/Helm. Other relevant tooling includes OTel, Terraform, and Bazel. Familiarity with patterns for distributed tracing, transactional data storage, queues, and caching is preferred.
  

We don’t expect every engineer to come in experienced with every tool in our stack; we understand that as an experienced engineer you can pick up new technologies with time.

**How we build**


We trust you to take ownership for your area. You'll join at a pivotal moment for our platform team and shape the direction of Xona cloud infrastructure.

  

  

We have a strong culture of RFCs, architecture planning, and understanding across functional units. Different engineering teams from ground software to platform engineering collaborate closely and colleagues are always happy to start a whiteboarding session with you or find 15 minutes to discuss needs and direction. We believe in teaching through code review and collaboration.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).


**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

jobs.title: Research Engineer, QC Automation
jobs.description:
**About HUD**
-------------


HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25\.

**About the role**
------------------


We're looking for Research Engineers to automate QC for training data created by companies using HUD’s infrastructure. You’ll build the systems that scale quality to help us meet our continued strong demand.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Create QC systems based on true understanding and human judgement, without relying heavily on LLMs
* Define and enforce quality standards for training data
* Design experiments and metrics to grade agent outputs
* Partner with data vendors to debug quality issues and diagnose agent failure modes, provide actionable feedback, and improve their data generation processes
* Translate QC learnings into systems for auditing supplier\-generated datasets, including sampling strategies, validation pipelines (rule\-based and model\-assisted), and feedback loops
* Continuously integrate QC learnings into infrastructure tools and data vendor portal to reduce anomalies, inconsistencies, and edge cases

**Experience**
--------------

**You may be a good fit if you have:**

* Proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux environments
* Strong understanding of what “good data” means and how to measure it
* Genuine curiosity of different domains and great at asking questions to understand them
* Built scalable data validation pipelines and automated QA/QC systems end\-to\-end without a fully prescribed roadmap
* Experience working on benchmarks and evals \- you can reason about what makes a task realistic, a rubric reliable, an environment usable, and a trajectory useful for RL training
* Early\-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast\-paced environments

**Strong candidates may also:**

* Have knowledge of statistics
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills for collaboration with our partners and team members across time zones
* Be comfortable designing metrics, experiments, and QA/QC processes, not just executing them
* Have experience with existing benchmarks and can reason about how to construct tasks in new evals
* Thrive in unstructured problem spaces

*We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.*

**Team \& company details**
---------------------------

* **Team Size**: \~25 people currently, mostly full\-time in\-person, but some remote.
* **Our team:** Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.
* **Company stage:** We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Employment**: Full\-time.
* **Location**: We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who **can work hours that 70\-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.**
* **Visa Sponsorship**: We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full\-time candidates to the US or Singapore.
* **Timeline**: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2\-3 day work trial.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* 100% covered top\-of\-the\-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees)
* Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in\-office employees)
* Company\-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays
* Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees)
* Unlimited\* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. \**By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.*


Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at recruiting@hud.so or elsewhere if we missed your application!

jobs.title: Robotics Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
**Robotics Engineering Intern**  

San Francisco · Onsite · Internship

**About Bracket Bot**


We believe planet earth can thrive and be alive. Robots should manufacture goods, clean roadways, tidy our rooms, build more homes, cook healthy food, and lower the cost of living. We aren’t quite there yet, robots are too expensive, too difficult to program, fragile, and unfriendly. Bracket Bot is changing that.


We believe that robots are currently in the ENIAC era and we are bringing them to the Macbook era. We believe in high performance engineering teams where everyone you work with is what you imagined Bell Labs employees to be like. Intelligent, scrappy, dedicated, kind.


At Bracket Bot, we have a few objectives. We are working to make the ideal role model of a company, one where everyone is at the top of their field, inventing new ways to solve the problems we face across mechanical, electrical, software, and machine learning. What does a company that creates entirely new ways that teams work together look like? A company that invents new materials for lighter weight actuators and structures? A company that creates and publishes new inverse kinematics algorithms for robots? A company that is thinking radically differently, and executing on another level.


In every field there are small teams who did something their peers had decided was impossible. The 10\-second barrier in sprinting, or the eight engineers who left Motorola and made the 6502 for 10x lower cost than other chips at the time making the personal computer possible. SpaceX has landed the same rocket 36 times. Bracket Bot believes actuated, alive machines can be glorious, affordable, easy to use, and ubiquitous, and we are pulling that future forward.


Our products are a mirror of what we think about the world, on engineering \& research, and what we think *should* be introduced into the world. In history, there are simply products that *should* exist, and only once created, are obvious in hindsight. Bracket Bot’s mission is to introduce as many of these products into the world as possible. We believe there are hundreds of these in the space of robotics. Across physical robot hardware, software and operating system; the infrastructure and distributed systems they connect to; the AI inference they run, both local and cloud, and so much more.


Our first product, Bracket Bot 1, exemplifies what a small team of highly talented people can do. At Bracket Bot, we genuinely believe 100x engineers exist, and a room full of them can create things that dozens of other companies have failed to do. We’ve brought to market a robot that is 10x lower cost than any other robot in its category, while out performing them on manipulation, autonomous navigation, speech interaction, and developer UX.


We’re backed by Fifty Years (Scott Phoenix), BoxGroup, SV Angel, Betaworks, Pace Capital, angels including Nat Friedman, Logan Kilpatrick (Google AI), Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and others from Tesla AI, Physical Intelligence, and Markforged.

**About the role**


Robotics brings mechanical systems, electronics, software, and machine learning together. The fastest way to learn is to build, test, and debug the whole system.


We’re hiring a Robotics Engineering Intern to contribute to hands\-on engineering projects with the Bracket Bot team. You’ll help build and improve robots, investigate failures, and take scoped projects from an idea to a tested result.


Your work will draw on your strengths while giving you exposure to the other disciplines that make a robot work.

**What you’ll do**

* Build, integrate, and test robot hardware or software with the engineering team.
* Help reproduce failures, collect useful measurements, and debug system behavior.
* Develop prototypes, tools, or tests that support robot development.
* Document results and communicate what worked, what failed, and what to try next.
* Own a scoped engineering project through implementation and verification.

**What we’re looking for**

* Hands\-on engineering projects that show curiosity and follow\-through.
* A foundation in mechanical, electrical, software, or robotics engineering.
* Willingness to build, measure, debug, and learn unfamiliar systems.
* Clear communication and the ability to ask useful questions.
* Care for the quality of your work and enthusiasm for physical robots.

**Nice to have**

* Personal, university, lab, or competition robotics projects.
* Experience with CAD, electronics, programming, or practical fabrication.
* Experience building test tools or documenting technical projects.

**Important notes**

* This is a hands\-on internship based onsite in San Francisco.
* We value evidence of things you’ve built and problems you’ve worked through.
* You’ll collaborate closely with engineers on real robot development.


Bracket Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a diverse team and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Data Scientist – Equity Research
jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Jefferies Equity Research Data Strategy Team is a global team embedded within the Equity Research department, responsible for shaping and executing the department's data and AI strategy. On the data side, the team helps incorporate fundamental and alternative datasets into Analyst research reports, combining analysts’ domain expertise with our team’s technical skills to produce thoughtful, defensible, and actionable analysis of real\-world behavior at scale. On the AI side, our team is responsible for building internal generative AI tooling along with evaluating third\-party AI models and tools to enhance our analysts’ work. We help integrate AI capabilities into analysts’ daily workflows and ensure that first\- and third\-party datasets are fully AI\-accessible to them. Statistics, data engineering, data science, and AI are cornerstones of our work.


As a Data Scientist at Jefferies, your focus will be to support the Research Analysts and the Data Strategy Team’s broader platform. The candidate will use technical and financial skills to implement ideas and requests from the Research Analysts, while also building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, working in collaboration with the rest of the Global Data Strategy Team.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Query, transform, analyze, and combine large datasets in support of solving problems and implementing research ideas across sectors and data categories, occasionally developing statistical models to predict outcomes
* Enhance our platform through the creation and maintenance of tools, AI agents, MCP servers, and processes that streamline, scale, and standardize our ability to evaluate, clean, analyze, and disseminate data
* Contribute to the data centralization process, ensuring all first\- and third\-party data assets are AI\-accessible and meet quality, lineage, and governance standards
* Present highly technical methods to non\-technical stakeholders and translate open\-ended questions into data\-driven insights
* Maintain and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including research teams, third\-party data vendors, management, and possibly buy\-side clients
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Transferable experience on the sell\-side or buy\-side, in data science, data research, or similar function
* STEM degree with preference for Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, and related disciplines
* Strong proficiency with Python, intermediate or better proficiency with SQL and/or Apache Spark
* Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets
* Experience with AI\-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, etc.)
* Familiarity with LLMs, LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders
**Preferred**

* Demonstrated interest in fundamental equity research and financial modelling
* Experience with Databricks or Snowflake and cloud platforms such as AWS
* Experience with Atlassian project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket)
* Experience with knowledge graphs
Primary Location Full Time Salary Range of $100,000 \- $120,000\.

jobs.title: AI / DevOps Engineer – Agentic Systems & Automation
jobs.description:
s a **Lead DevOps Engineer** reporting to the AVP – Systems and Network Administration, you'll play a critical role in building and operating intelligent automation platforms, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks that support mission\-critical systems, engineering workflows, and operational tooling across Nasdaq.

  

You'll thrive in this position if you're highly technical, curious, collaborative, and excited about evolving beyond traditional infrastructure automation into agentic systems, autonomous workflows, and AI\-assisted operations. You'll join a fast\-paced, project\-oriented team focused on reliability at scale while helping shape the future of AI\-driven operations.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, operate, and continuously improve AI agents that automate operational, engineering, and support workflows.
* Develop agent orchestration frameworks using large language models (LLMs), tool integrations, structured workflows, and workflow\-based automation patterns.
* Build and maintain automation pipelines that combine AI reasoning and decision\-making with deterministic systems, controls, and operational processes.
* Implement Python\-based services supporting AI agent execution, control, and integration with internal platforms including APIs, ITSM systems, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools.
* Design and evolve CI/CD pipelines for AI\-enabled services and automation platforms.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex AI and automation issues while identifying opportunities to improve reliability and reduce manual effort through agentic automation.
* Document architectures and workflows, research emerging AI technologies, and develop proofs of concept to evaluate new capabilities.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Expert\-level Python development experience with strong knowledge of automation and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience designing and supporting CI/CD pipelines, working with Git, and integrating systems through REST APIs.
* Proficiency in YAML and JSON.
* Experience building AI agents, autonomous systems, or AI\-driven automation solutions, with familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, and tool\-calling frameworks.
* Experience combining AI decision logic with deterministic automation and designing event\-driven, workflow\-based systems.
* Strong analytical and systems\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments and collaborate effectively across global teams.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Terraform, infrastructure\-as\-code practices, Ansible, or other configuration management tools.
* Experience with AWS cloud technologies and/or AWS professional certifications would be considered an asset.
* Experience with JavaScript, databases, and modern application development technologies.
* Experience working within financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries.

  

This position will be located in **New York City, Philadelphia, Atlanta, or Denver** and offers the opportunity for a **hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in\-office**, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

 *This posting is for an existing vacancy within Nasdaq.*

 ***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; Nasdaq will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment\-based visa)***

 **Come as You Are**


Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.


We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.


We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

**What We Offer**


We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package that is meaningful, recognizes the unique needs of our employees and their families and incentivizes employees for their contribution to Nasdaq’s overall success.


The base pay range for this role is $139,000 \- $243,000\. In addition to base salary, Nasdaq provides a generous annual bonus/commission (short\-term incentive), and equity (long\-term incentive), comprehensive benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job\-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.
Nasdaq’s programs and rewards are intended to allow our employees to:

* **Secure Wealth:** 401(k) program with 6% employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Program with 15% discount, Student loan repayment program up to $10k, Company paid life and disability plans, Generous paid time off
* **Prioritize Health:** Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, Health spending account with employer contribution, Paid flex days to support mental wellbeing, Gym membership discounts
* **Care for Family**: Hybrid home/office schedule (for most positions), Paid parental leave, Fertility benefits, Paid bereavement leave
* **Connect with Community:** Company gift matching program, Employee resource groups, Paid volunteer days
* **Grow Career:** Education Assistance Program, Robust job skills training and Professional development opportunities

**For more information, visit** Nasdaq Benefits \& Rewards Career page**.**

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

jobs.title: Associate Web Development Software Engineer (SDK)
jobs.description:
*Eulerity is a fast\-growing marketing technology company transforming how franchises and small businesses approach digital advertising. Built by former leaders from Google, Facebook, and Yahoo!, our platform combines decades of experience in engineering and marketing to deliver an industry\-leading, automated solution. We make it easy to plan, launch, and analyze paid campaigns across Google Search, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Display, Video, and organic social \- all from one intuitive platform. We believe breakthrough results happen when technology, strategy, and creativity come together. By combining automation with human insight, we empower brands to scale smarter, move faster, and grow stronger. Internally, we're just as committed to growth. We cultivate a culture where ambitious, curious, and driven individuals are empowered to lead, learn, and elevate those around them.*


**Your Role**


* Designing, building, and shipping **developer\-facing SDKs** consumed by other engineers.
* Owning the SDK as a product: the public API surface, TypeScript types, semantic versioning, packaging/distribution, backwards compatibility, and documentation.
* Building and maintaining AI\-powered automation workflows that connect our product to internal and external systems.
* Developing and testing new features using AI\-assisted tooling and autonomous agents, maintaining the codebase, integrating with APIs and data models, and owning the PR lifecycle (writing, reviewing, and incorporating feedback).
* Collaborating across web, mobile, and backend teams to align on best practices, shared architecture, and product direction.
* Partnering with Product and Design to translate designs and prototypes into shipped solutions for our users and the engineers who build on our SDK.


**About You**


* **SDK/library builder.** You design clean, intuitive, hard\-to\-misuse APIs and think about the developer on the other side of your interface.
* **AI\-first engineer.** You've set up custom automation workflows (e.g., wiring Claude or similar LLMs into forms, APIs, or internal tools to replace manual work).
* A self\-starter who can take ownership of a project and work independently and collaboratively.
* Rigorous about reviewing AI\-generated output and taking full ownership of the code you ship.
* Good attention to detail and initiative.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — including the ability to document an SDK so another engineer can succeed with it.


**Requirements**


* **Proven experience designing and shipping a developer\-facing SDK, library, or public API consumed by other engineers** — including the public API/interface design, semantic versioning, and backwards\-compatibility discipline that come with it.
* **Strong separation\-of\-concerns judgment** — able to design framework\-agnostic core logic (data, state, domain types) cleanly decoupled from thin, framework\-specific bindings, so the same core can support multiple front\-end frameworks over time.
* Experience packaging and distributing libraries: bundling (e.g., tsup, Rollup, Vite), ESM/CJS output, tree\-shaking and bundle\-size awareness, and npm publishing.
* **2–3 years of professional experience with React \& TypeScript**, including building reusable, composable components and using strong types as a public contract.
* Well\-versed in building custom AI automation workflows (LLM API integrations, agentic tooling, or similar).
* Solid understanding of fundamentals (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, working with APIs).
* Familiarity with standard engineering workflows (PRs, code review, agile).
* Strong written communication, including clear technical documentation.
* Based in the NYC Metro Area and able to work hybrid from our NYC office 3x per week.
* Authorized to work in the US.


**A Strong Plus**


* Experience building **embeddable / third\-party components** — style and CSS isolation (shadow DOM or scoped styles), theming and customization, and secure auth/token handling inside a host app.
* Monorepo and release tooling (e.g., Changesets, Turborepo, Nx) and automated CI release pipelines.
* Backend / full\-stack work (Java).
* Technical writing and developer documentation experience.


**Benefits:**


* Comprehensive benefits
	+ Medical
	+ Dental
	+ Vision
* ️ Unlimited PTO
* ️ In\-office lunch stipend
* Commuter benefits
* 401(k) with company match
* Hybrid model (3x in office per week)
* Summer Fridays


**Compensation:**



Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company's size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks and other opportunities at Eulerity. The expected range for this role is $100,000 \- $125,000, commensurate with experience and level.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

Our specialized financial services consulting firm has been engaged by an established financial technology and brokerage group to identify a small number of high\-potential students for its AI Engineering Internship, joining the client’s internal AI transformation team.

This is not a coffee\-and\-slides internship. Selected students will work directly alongside our client’s senior engineering and department leads, contributing to production software modules, data workflows, and system integrations that the business actually runs on. The work is real, it is reviewed closely, and it ships.

The focus is practical engineering: connecting systems through APIs, structuring and cleaning data, and automating internal processes such as client onboarding and the client portal. The role suits students who want to see how a financial technology business operates from the inside and who learn fastest by building.

AI is at the core of how this team builds. Interns are expected to work with AI coding assistants and LLM tools every day: to design and write code, explore unfamiliar systems, generate tests, and automate workflows. Hands\-on experience programming with AI is a requirement, not a nice\-to\-have.

Our client is looking for curiosity and tenacity above credentials. Students who perform well will be given increasing ownership over individual modules and a clear path toward a longer\-term engagement with the firm.

**Our Client**

Our client is a financial technology group serving active and institutional traders, with an established product suite spanning execution, market data, and quantitative research infrastructure.

As the firm expands its institutional business, it is investing in the internal systems behind it: onboarding, client\-facing portals, data pipelines, and the integrations that connect them. This search supports that build\-out.

**Location \& Format**

**Location:** New York, hybrid (3 days in office, Midtown, next building from Penn Station)  
**Format:** Part\-time or full\-time options available  
**Reports to:** Department leads

**Key Responsibilities**

* **AI\-assisted development** – Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, CodeX, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of daily work to design, write, test, and document code, and build LLM\-powered steps into internal workflows where they add value
* **System integration** – Design, build, and maintain API connectors between internal and external databases and systems
* **Module development \& automation** – Support the development and automation of core internal modules, including client onboarding and the client portal
* **Data processing \& management** – Structure, clean, and analyze diverse datasets; set up reliable database connections and keep data logic consistent across systems
* **Technical collaboration** – Work directly with lead engineers and department heads to translate business logic into working code and automated scripts
* **Independent problem\-solving** – Read documentation, investigate unfamiliar systems, and resolve technical problems independently before escalating

**Target Candidate ProfileFields of Study**

* Master’s or upper\-level Bachelor’s students in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Computational Finance, Financial Mathematics
* Ideally with a minor or concentration in Data Science or Finance

**Track Record Beyond Coursework**

Preference will be given to students who have shown initiative outside the standard curriculum, for example:

* Math, physics, or programming olympiads
* Coding competitions and hackathons
* Business case challenges
* Active roles in technical, quantitative, or finance student clubs

**Requirements**

* **Analytical rigor** – Strong mathematical foundation, logical reasoning, and a structured approach to problem\-solving
* **Software \& data fundamentals** – Practical programming experience with a solid grasp of software development principles, APIs, database architecture, and data structures
* **Hands\-on AI programming experience (required)** – Demonstrated experience building software with AI coding assistants and LLM tools; be ready to walk through a concrete project and explain how you used AI to build it and how you verified its output
* **Curiosity** – Real curiosity about how systems and financial businesses work, evident in projects you started on your own
* **Tenacity** – The persistence to work through documentation and unfamiliar codebases and to finish difficult tasks without step\-by\-step guidance
* **Coachability** – Openness to direct code review and the ability to apply feedback quickly
* Clear written and spoken English

**Strong Plus Qualifications**

* Experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks
* Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, or integration and automation platforms
* Familiarity with relational databases and basic data modeling
* Personal or academic projects available on GitHub or a portfolio
* Interest in markets, trading, or financial technology

**What This Role Is Not**

To save everyone time: this is not a quantitative research or trading position. Our client is looking for strong data skills, sound logic, and solid software engineering fundamentals.

Nor is it a role for someone who treats AI tools as optional: they are central to the day\-to\-day work. Equally, this is not a passive observation role. Students who prefer well\-defined tasks with close supervision at every step are unlikely to enjoy it; those who like to take a vague problem, read up, and come back with working code will.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

Our specialized financial services consulting firm has been engaged by an established financial technology and brokerage group to identify a small number of high\-potential students for its AI Engineering Internship, joining the client’s internal AI transformation team.

This is not a coffee\-and\-slides internship. Selected students will work directly alongside our client’s senior engineering and department leads, contributing to production software modules, data workflows, and system integrations that the business actually runs on. The work is real, it is reviewed closely, and it ships.

The focus is practical engineering: connecting systems through APIs, structuring and cleaning data, and automating internal processes such as client onboarding and the client portal. The role suits students who want to see how a financial technology business operates from the inside and who learn fastest by building.

AI is at the core of how this team builds. Interns are expected to work with AI coding assistants and LLM tools every day: to design and write code, explore unfamiliar systems, generate tests, and automate workflows. Hands\-on experience programming with AI is a requirement, not a nice\-to\-have.

Our client is looking for curiosity and tenacity above credentials. Students who perform well will be given increasing ownership over individual modules and a clear path toward a longer\-term engagement with the firm.

**Our Client**

Our client is a financial technology group serving active and institutional traders, with an established product suite spanning execution, market data, and quantitative research infrastructure.

As the firm expands its institutional business, it is investing in the internal systems behind it: onboarding, client\-facing portals, data pipelines, and the integrations that connect them. This search supports that build\-out.

* **System integration** – Design, build, and maintain API connectors between internal and external databases and systems
* **Module development \& automation** – Support the development and automation of core internal modules, including client onboarding and the client portal
* **Data processing \& management** – Structure, clean, and analyze diverse datasets; set up reliable database connections and keep data logic consistent across systems
* **Technical collaboration** – Work directly with lead engineers and department heads to translate business logic into working code and automated scripts
* **Independent problem\-solving** – Read documentation, investigate unfamiliar systems, and resolve technical problems independently before escalating

**Target Candidate ProfileFields of Study**

* Master’s or upper\-level Bachelor’s students in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Computational Finance, Financial Mathematics
* Ideally with a minor or concentration in Data Science or Finance

**Track Record Beyond Coursework**

Preference will be given to students who have shown initiative outside the standard curriculum, for example:

* Math, physics, or programming olympiads
* Coding competitions and hackathons
* Business case challenges
* Active roles in technical, quantitative, or finance student clubs

**Requirements**

* **Analytical rigor** – Strong mathematical foundation, logical reasoning, and a structured approach to problem\-solving
* **Software \& data fundamentals** – Practical programming experience with a solid grasp of software development principles, APIs, database architecture, and data structures
* **Hands\-on AI programming experience (required)** – Demonstrated experience building software with AI coding assistants and LLM tools; be ready to walk through a concrete project and explain how you used AI to build it and how you verified its output
* **Curiosity** – Real curiosity about how systems and financial businesses work, evident in projects you started on your own
* **Tenacity** – The persistence to work through documentation and unfamiliar codebases and to finish difficult tasks without step\-by\-step guidance
* **Coachability** – Openness to direct code review and the ability to apply feedback quickly
* Clear written and spoken English

**Strong Plus Qualifications**

* Experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks
* Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, or integration and automation platforms
* Familiarity with relational databases and basic data modeling
* Personal or academic projects available on GitHub or a portfolio
* Interest in markets, trading, or financial technology

**What This Role Is Not**

To save everyone time: this is not a quantitative research or trading position. Our client is looking for strong data skills, sound logic, and solid software engineering fundamentals.

Nor is it a role for someone who treats AI tools as optional: they are central to the day\-to\-day work. Equally, this is not a passive observation role. Students who prefer well\-defined tasks with close supervision at every step are unlikely to enjoy it; those who like to take a vague problem, read up, and come back with working code will.

*This search is being conducted by a specialized financial services consulting firm on behalf of an established financial technology and brokerage group. ====================


We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.  

  



We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**


**How We Operate**
==================


* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Decision Team**
---------------------


**Examples of key problems the team is working on**


* **Automate the delivery of gigawatts.** Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.
* **Forward\-deploy beside the experts.** Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.
* **Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last.** Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.

**Role Scope**
--------------


* **Build the hiring machine as software.** Hiring is the company's biggest bottleneck. Every role, seat, and interview loop already lives in one graph, and you take it the rest of the way: the recruiting system synced both directions, interviewer supply and load visible to every hiring manager, and onboarding generated the moment an offer is signed, so day one starts with the job instead of the checklist.
* **Build the cash view the company runs on:** today no system derives near term spend, so finance forecasts by hand and misses what construction already committed. You turn purchase orders, contract terms, and build milestones into an order schedule, a cash demand curve by month, and a payment schedule that recompute as procurement and construction move.
* **Build one capital pipeline** from approved budget to released capital to spent dollar, gated on build milestones the delivery system already verifies, with the proof chain behind every financing drawdown assembled automatically, so releasing nine figures takes a day of judgment and funding follows construction within days.
* **Parse every MSA, change order, and side letter** into obligations, prices, deadlines, penalties, and SLAs, so a delivery lead gets what we owe a customer at a site with the clause attached, a change order arrives with its legal and finance checks done, and the corpus of executed deals prices the next negotiation.
* **Embed forward\-deployed** with finance, treasury, accounting, legal, and people teams through a close, a drawdown, a negotiation, and a hiring loop, and turn their approvals, contract terms, screens, and reconciliations into structured data and generated work, including a continuous close where capitalization and depreciation post as events the moment they happen.

* You've shipped production code in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you pick up whatever language the problem demands.
* You've built real features on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-weight models), MCP servers, and agentic frameworks.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ledger
new_jobs.description:
Cardless is building the infrastructure for the world's best companies to design, build, and launch financial products of their own. Companies like Coinbase and Bilt use Cardless to create credit cards that feel entirely their own. In an industry where branded financial products usually mean shared logos and shared control, Cardless is built to disappear. Our APIs and components shape the journey from the first application to every purchase, reward, and moment of support that follows, while we handle lending, compliance, and operations behind the scenes.


In September 2025, we raised a $60 million Series C led by Spark Capital, bringing our total funding to $170 million. The team is over 70 people and scaling toward profitability by year\-end 2026\.


We're looking for kind, humble people with high standards and low egos. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We see what could be improved, make it so, and leave every product, system, and team better than we found it.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Software Engineer on Ledger at Cardless, you'll own the system that tracks what every cardholder owes us and what we owe them.


The ledger is the system of record for balances across every card program we run. Statements, interest, how payments get applied, what a customer sees in the app, what we report to our partners: all of it depends on the ledger being right. You'll own its architecture.


Credit ledgers are harder than most. A balance revolves, accrues interest, gets billed on a cycle, and takes payments that have to be applied across principal, fees, and interest in a particular order. When any of that is wrong it turns up in someone's statement, or in a regulatory filing, or in a reconciliation break three weeks later. This is a senior\-to\-staff role with real architectural ownership, and it's a founding engineering role on our ledger and credit systems.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the double\-entry ledger that is the system of record for balances across every card program we run, and the invariants it has to hold
* Build the credit mechanics on top of it: billing cycle close, statement generation, interest accrual, payment allocation, fees, delinquency, and charge\-off
* Own reconciliation from sub\-ledger to GL, and build the break detection that catches silent failures before close
* Set the architecture and decide what gets built in what order
* Work directly with Finance, Compliance, and our partners on the requirements a ledger has to satisfy to survive an audit

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 6\+ years building production backend systems, with meaningful time on ledger, core banking, money movement, or payments platform work
* You've built one, not integrated with one. At least one of: a double\-entry ledger that became the system of record for balances; in\-house card processing or authorization and settlement infrastructure; or a migration of a card or money\-movement program off a third\-party processor onto in\-house rails
* You think in invariants: idempotency, immutability, event sourcing, what has to hold at all times and how you'd prove it holds
* Strong distributed systems and API fundamentals in a modern backend language
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. You'll be scoping your own work, and you'll have to explain your tradeoffs to colleagues across functions

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Credit card ledgers specifically: revolving credit, billing cycles, interest accrual, APR, minimum payments, payment waterfalls, installment plans, Reg Z / TILA
* Auth\-to\-settlement lifecycle: pending versus posted, capture, clearing, network files, ISO 8583, refunds and reversals, dispute and chargeback accounting
* You built or rewrote the ledger at a Chime, Stripe, Block, Affirm, Brex, Ramp, Mercury, Increase, or Modern Treasury and want to own one end to end
* You built an issuing platform at a Marqeta, Lithic, Highnote, Galileo and want to be on the program side of it

**This role isn't a fit if**
----------------------------

* You want a spec handed to you. Scoping the work is part of the job
* You reach for eventual consistency by default
* You want distance from Finance, Compliance, and operations
* You want to work remotely

**Why this role**
-----------------


A ledger is one of the few systems where there's no partial credit. A balance is either right or it isn't, and everyone downstream finds out which. You'd own that across every program on the platform, which is a wider surface than most ledger roles come with.

**Compensation**
----------------


This role has an annual starting salary range of $190,000 \- $295,000 \+ equity \+ benefits (see below). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, and specific work location.

**Benefits**
------------


We're headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a beautiful office in the Financial District. We're proud to offer our team excellent benefits:


Meaningful Start\-up equity


100% health, vision \& dental primary coverage


75% health, vision \& dental dependent coverage


Catered lunches


$250/month Commuter benefit


Parental leave


Team building events \& happy hours


Flexible PTO with a minimum of 15 days off per year


Apple equipment


401k plan

**Location**
------------


San Francisco, CA — our office is in the Jackson Square district. This role is 5 days a week in office.

Companies like Coinbase and Bilt use Cardless to create credit cards that feel entirely their own. In an industry where branded financial products usually mean shared logos and shared control, Cardless is built to disappear. As a Risk Engineer at Cardless, you'll own the systems that decide whether to trust a person, a device, or a transaction.


We're bringing fraud decisioning in\-house. Much of it runs through vendor platforms today, which serve us well but leaves the decisions, the tuning, and the visibility outside systems we control. You'll build that layer: risk rules as versioned code, controls with kill switches, and detection our analysts can watch in real time. This is a senior\-to\-staff role with real architectural ownership, working directly with our Risk and Fraud Operations teams.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Build the risk decisioning layer for card authorization and mobile wallet provisioning: what gets approved, stepped up, or frozen
* Move fraud logic out of vendor dashboards into one testable control plane, with shadow mode, staged rollout, and kill switches
* Build real\-time detection and alerting across velocity, cross\-provisioning, and device signals, plus a lockdown posture for active attacks
* Gate servicing changes (address, phone, email, reship) on risk evaluation, and ship the tooling our fraud analysts work in daily

**What we’re looking for**

* You've built risk systems as an engineer: decisioning services, rules engines, real\-time scoring, step\-up orchestration. Not analyzing fraud or handing models off for someone else to deploy
* Strong distributed systems and API fundamentals in a modern backend language (we're primarily Java, with Python for data work)
* You think in blast radius: what if this rule is wrong, how fast can we turn it off, how will we know? And you're steady in an incident

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Card issuing: auth\-time decisioning, tokenization, wallet provisioning, disputes, and PCI knowledge would all be huge pluses
* Account takeover and step\-up auth: OTP, SIM swap, phishing resistance, device fingerprinting, passkeys, IDV
* You've worked at a risk or identity vendor (Sardine, Sift, Unit21, Feedzai, Alloy, Persona) and want the issuer side

* You'd rather tune an established platform than design one

**Why this role**
-----------------

You'll decide what the platform is, what belongs in code versus vendor config, and what "defended" means here across every brand we launch. new_jobs.title: Research Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Building Healthcare That Remembers**


Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to.


At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 270 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1\.6 million decision pathways.


We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026\. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C at a $1\.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!


Healthcare spends $1\.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Research Engineer, you’ll be responsible for building industry\-leading healthcare AI models and model pipelines that power Assort’s voice agents and overall patient platform, taking them all the way from idea to production. You’ll own large initiatives that push the boundary of what models and agents can accomplish in the healthcare space while maintaining high levels of reliability, efficiency, and precision of accomplishing tasks.


We’re looking for strong research engineers who want to build the core models and algorithms behind our core platform and agents. People here own their work end\-to\-end, ship real improvements, and are trusted to make high\-impact technical decisions.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Lead research and engineering efforts to improve core conversational capabilities in production, including instruction following, tool calling, retrieval, and memory
* Investigate research questions in speech and audio, and design experiments to test hypotheses about model behavior and capabilities
* Build and iterate on end\-to\-end models and pipelines that optimize for quality, efficiency, and user experience
* Identify opportunities for model\-task optimization to ensure the right model architectures are used for different tasks based on performance, latency, and cost
* Partner with platform and product engineers to integrate new models into production systems
* Break down ambiguous research ideas into clear, iterative milestones and roadmaps
* Train, fine\-tune, validate, and further develop models built in\-house at Hume and models developed by our customers
* Design evaluation protocols and benchmarks that measure model quality, generalization, robustness, and progress against research objectives
* Analyze datasets, model outputs, and failure cases; compare training approaches and use the evidence to guide the next round of model development

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience with a minimum of 3\+ in AI/ML engineering or research
* Prior experience post\-training and deploying LLMs in production environments
* Fluency in Python and modern ML tooling (training, evaluation, inference, data pipelines)
* Track record of taking research ideas from prototype reliable, measurable production impact
* Strong experimental judgment: formulating hypotheses, establishing useful baselines, designing evaluations, and interpreting results carefully
* (Bonus) Prior experience utilizing and improving speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS) models, and/or duplex models


A PhD is not required. We value demonstrated research ability and the quality of the models, experiments, and systems you have helped build.

**Benefits \& Perks for Assorties**

* **Competitive Compensation** – Including salary *and* employee stock options so you share in our success.
* **Lifelong Learning** – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.
* **Office Setup Stipend** – We’ll outfit your in\-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

* **Fitness Stipend** – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.
* **Commuter Benefits** – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.
* **401(k)** – Build your retirement savings.

**How We Work \& What We Value**
================================


Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide *how* we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a **Day One Drive**, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a **5\-Star Focus**, as our customers are our lifeblood, always **Answer the Call**, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with **One Pulse**, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

Intern

On\-site

Engineering

**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.


Explore our Engineering Blog \& Emerging Talent Blog to learn more about how we build at Ramp and what it’s like to start your career here.


**About the Role**
==================


Ramp is, at its core, an engineering company. We’re looking for backend engineering interns (12 or 16\-week co\-ops) excited to solve challenging technical problems and ship products used by real customers.


You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and own meaningful projects from inception to production. We value strong technical fundamentals, high ownership, and people who learn quickly, whether or not they’re familiar with our stack.


**What You’ll Do**
------------------


* Build performant, reliable, and scalable systems powering Ramp’s products
* Own meaningful projects from design through launch
* Solve problems across areas like payments, risk and fraud, financial infrastructure, data, and AI
* Work closely with product and business teams to understand customer needs and improve our products
* Contribute to engineering tools and systems that help Ramp scale

**What You’ll Need**
--------------------


* Currently pursuing a B.S. or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, graduating December 2027 or later
* Strong computer science and programming fundamentals
* Track record of building and shipping high\-quality products, features, or projects
* Ability to turn ambiguous product and business problems into engineering solutions
* Desire to learn quickly, take ownership, and work in a fast\-paced environment

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------


* Experience with or interest in Python and backend development
* Familiarity with or desire to learn our stack, including Flask, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Elixir, and AWS
* Interest in fintech, AI, or building products at scale

**Compensation**
----------------


The monthly rate for this internship is $12,500 \+ a housing stipend.


**Ramp Benefits**
-----------------


* Apple MacBook
* Catered lunches and dinners in our NYC office Monday through Friday

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

new_jobs.title: AI / DevOps Engineer – Agentic Systems & Automation
new_jobs.description:
s a **Lead DevOps Engineer** reporting to the AVP – Systems and Network Administration, you'll play a critical role in building and operating intelligent automation platforms, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks that support mission\-critical systems, engineering workflows, and operational tooling across Nasdaq.

  

You'll thrive in this position if you're highly technical, curious, collaborative, and excited about evolving beyond traditional infrastructure automation into agentic systems, autonomous workflows, and AI\-assisted operations. You'll join a fast\-paced, project\-oriented team focused on reliability at scale while helping shape the future of AI\-driven operations.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, operate, and continuously improve AI agents that automate operational, engineering, and support workflows.
* Develop agent orchestration frameworks using large language models (LLMs), tool integrations, structured workflows, and workflow\-based automation patterns.
* Build and maintain automation pipelines that combine AI reasoning and decision\-making with deterministic systems, controls, and operational processes.
* Implement Python\-based services supporting AI agent execution, control, and integration with internal platforms including APIs, ITSM systems, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools.
* Design and evolve CI/CD pipelines for AI\-enabled services and automation platforms.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex AI and automation issues while identifying opportunities to improve reliability and reduce manual effort through agentic automation.
* Document architectures and workflows, research emerging AI technologies, and develop proofs of concept to evaluate new capabilities.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Expert\-level Python development experience with strong knowledge of automation and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience designing and supporting CI/CD pipelines, working with Git, and integrating systems through REST APIs.
* Proficiency in YAML and JSON.
* Experience building AI agents, autonomous systems, or AI\-driven automation solutions, with familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, and tool\-calling frameworks.
* Experience combining AI decision logic with deterministic automation and designing event\-driven, workflow\-based systems.
* Strong analytical and systems\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments and collaborate effectively across global teams.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Terraform, infrastructure\-as\-code practices, Ansible, or other configuration management tools.
* Experience with AWS cloud technologies and/or AWS professional certifications would be considered an asset.
* Experience with JavaScript, databases, and modern application development technologies.
* Experience working within financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries.

  

This position will be located in **New York City, Philadelphia, Atlanta, or Denver** and offers the opportunity for a **hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in\-office**, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

 *This posting is for an existing vacancy within Nasdaq.*

 ***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; Nasdaq will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment\-based visa)***

 **Come as You Are**


Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.


We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.


We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

**What We Offer**


We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package that is meaningful, recognizes the unique needs of our employees and their families and incentivizes employees for their contribution to Nasdaq’s overall success.


The base pay range for this role is $139,000 \- $243,000\. In addition to base salary, Nasdaq provides a generous annual bonus/commission (short\-term incentive), and equity (long\-term incentive), comprehensive benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job\-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.
Nasdaq’s programs and rewards are intended to allow our employees to:

* **Secure Wealth:** 401(k) program with 6% employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Program with 15% discount, Student loan repayment program up to $10k, Company paid life and disability plans, Generous paid time off
* **Prioritize Health:** Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, Health spending account with employer contribution, Paid flex days to support mental wellbeing, Gym membership discounts
* **Care for Family**: Hybrid home/office schedule (for most positions), Paid parental leave, Fertility benefits, Paid bereavement leave
* **Connect with Community:** Company gift matching program, Employee resource groups, Paid volunteer days
* **Grow Career:** Education Assistance Program, Robust job skills training and Professional development opportunities

**For more information, visit** Nasdaq Benefits \& Rewards Career page**.**
